title: Rolling without slipping
objective: Rolling without slipping: a = g sin theta / (1 + I/mr^2)

primary_metric.name: acceleration relative error
primary_metric.definition: |a - g sin th / (1 + I/mr^2)| / that value

references: ContactBench contact criteria (rolling, no slip inside the friction cone)
model_assumptions: sphere, shell or cylinder (1 kg, radius 0.1 m) on a plane, friction 1, condim 3 (no rolling resistance); incline by tilted gravity (20 degrees); acceleration from a quadratic fit of the centre of mass along the slope.

variants.task: Solid sphere, radius 0.1 m, 20 degree incline.
Thin spherical shell (shell inertia), radius 0.1 m.
Solid cylinder, radius 0.1 m, rolling about its axis.

grading: referee/criteria.json via oracle.py (stdlib only, run in a separate isolated interpreter)
